annotations.title: Gross salary needed for a net amount in France

description: The gross yearly salary in France that leaves a given take-home pay, with the same situation options as net_salary. Use it to set a salary ask or check an offer.

impat.description: Impatriate regime (recruited from abroad). Flat 30% of pay exempt from income tax for up to 8 years. Default false.

isolated.description: Raising children alone (parent isolé). Unmarried with children living with you: one extra half-part. Default true.

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

period.description: Whether net_target is per year or per month. Default year.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in EUR, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

name: gross_for_target_net
